changelog: - **The marketing account spreadsheet can be imported, idempotently** (#2404, #2405, #2406, #2407 — story #2391, epic #2348). A written column contract ([`docs/marketing-import.md`](docs/marketing-import.md)) plus a sample file with its four edge cases (`scripts/fixtures/marketing-accounts-sample.csv`), and an importer that runs on the SHARED engine — `runImport({ parse, validate, resolve, apply })` and the shared delimited parser in `src/lib/importPreview.ts`, the same ones the roster feed uses. No second parser, no second dry-run engine, and no `if (dryRun)` branch in the planning path: a dry run is the same call with a writer that does not write, and `npm run import:marketing-accounts` is dry-run by default (`--apply` to write, `--owner=<email>` for the organisation and the default funnel owner, following `scripts/import-csv.mjs`'s flags). `Company` gains `vatId`, `country` (ISO-3166-1 alpha-2) with `@@unique([orgId, vatId])` — org-scoped, never global, because two tenants may each hold the same merchant — and `contactName`/`contactPhone` beside the existing `contactEmail`; all four nullable, so `db push` applies to populated tables. Matching is VAT id first, then `normalizeNameKey(name) + country` through the repo's existing normaliser, which transliterates İ/ı/ş/ğ/ü/ö/ç before lowercasing (a plain `toLowerCase()` makes `İstanbul Tekstil A.Ş.` and `ISTANBUL TEKSTIL A.S.` two accounts on every run), and it is batched — three queries per run, not three per row. A bad row is reported as `{row, key, status:'ERROR', reason}` and never thrown; a second apply of the same file is all `UNCHANGED`. The data-model decision the rest of the backlog rests on is now written down in `docs/marketing-vertical/pipeline-record.md` and linked from that folder's README: account = `Company`, funnel record = `MentorshipRelation` (owner = `mentorId`, lead person = `menteeId`, account = `companyId`), lead person = a `MENTEE` `User` — no second pipeline carrier, and stage history stays `StatusChange` on the relation rather than a Company-level table. A row with a stage but no primary contact keeps its account and skips the stage with a warning, because a funnel record needs a person. Unit-tested dependency-free with an in-memory writer (`npm run test:marketing-import`, 24 cases, `src/lib/marketingImport.ts` floored at 95%).

en: An account list kept in a spreadsheet can now be imported: companies, their VAT id, country and primary contact, and where each one sits in the funnel. It previews before it writes, and running the same file twice changes nothing.
tr: Elektronik tabloda tutulan müşteri listesi artık içe aktarılabiliyor: firmalar, vergi numarası, ülke ve birincil muhatap ile her birinin funnel'daki yeri. Yazmadan önce önizleme veriyor; aynı dosyayı ikinci kez çalıştırmak hiçbir şeyi değiştirmiyor.
de: Eine in einer Tabelle gepflegte Kundenliste lässt sich jetzt importieren: Firmen mit USt-IdNr., Land und Ansprechpartner sowie ihre Position im Funnel. Der Lauf zeigt erst eine Vorschau, und dieselbe Datei ein zweites Mal einzulesen ändert nichts.
